Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From c14556fc0c7c115ffb4a287560e1ec9f7869aac3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mika Westerberg <mika.westerberg@linux.intel.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2020 12:39:11 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] thunderbolt: Drop duplicated 0x prefix from format string

The tb_dbg() call is using %#x that already adds the 0x prefix so don't
duplicate it.

Fixes: 9039387e166e ("thunderbolt: Add USB4 router operation proxy for firmware connection manager")
Signed-off-by: Mika Westerberg <mika.westerberg@linux.intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Yehezkel Bernat <YehezkelShB@gmail.com>

diff --git a/drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c b/drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c
index 8b7f941a9bb7..b8c4159bc32d 100644
--- a/drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c
+++ b/drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c
@@ -2316,7 +2316,7 @@ static int icm_usb4_switch_nvm_authenticate_status(struct tb_switch *sw,
 
 	if (auth && auth->reply.route_hi == sw->config.route_hi &&
 	    auth->reply.route_lo == sw->config.route_lo) {
-		tb_dbg(tb, "NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags 0x%#x status %#x\n",
+		tb_dbg(tb, "NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags %#x status %#x\n",
 		       tb_route(sw), auth->reply.hdr.flags, auth->reply.status);
 		if (auth->reply.hdr.flags & ICM_FLAGS_ERROR)
 			ret = -EIO;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/thunderbolt/icm.c`**
   - The format string in the `tb_dbg()` function call was modified. The original string included a duplicated `0x` prefix for the `flags` argument, which was formatted using `%#x`. The modification removed the additional `0x` prefix, changing the line from:
     ```c
     tb_dbg(tb, "NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags 0x%#x status %#x\n",
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     tb_dbg(tb, "NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags %#x status %#x\n",
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in the format string is aimed at correcting the output of the `tb_dbg()` function to avoid redundancy in the representation of the `flags` argument. The original format was misleading as it included an unnecessary `0x` prefix, which is already added by the `%#x` format specifier. This modification enhances the clarity and correctness of the debug output without altering the functionality of the code. The patch is linked to a previous commit that introduced the `tb_dbg()` call, indicating that this fix is a refinement of that earlier implementation.


The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
tb_dbg(tb, "NVM_AUTH found for %llx flags %#x status %#x\n",
```
Reason:
By removing the duplicated `0x` prefix from the format string, the output is corrected to only include a single `0x` prefix for the `flags` argument, ensuring clarity and correctness in the debug output.
